title: 道富环球：通胀现二阶效应，美联储或比市场预期更鹰派
speaker: Ben Lux

segments.en: I we do we do disagree and and there's a reason for this so um we we have our own way of calculating inflation and it's called the state street price stats.
segments.zh: 我们确实不同意市场观点，原因在于我们有自己计算通胀的方法，即道富价格统计。

segments.en: It's an online inflation metric that we use which now the fed also uses as an alternative of data.
segments.zh: 这是我们使用的在线通胀指标，美联储也将其作为替代数据参考。

segments.en: Uh, and what we see from our data your metric. You mean just yes, the state should price that state that the fed also takes into consideration as well.
segments.zh: 从我们的数据中可以看到，美联储也会考虑这一指标。

segments.en: What we're now starting to see is a second order effect in the inflation. So we pass that oil concern where obviously oil has come down a bit and you're starting to see that in a transport crisis.
segments.zh: 我们现在开始看到通胀中的二阶效应。油价担忧已过，油价有所回落，这在运输成本中有所体现。

segments.en: But what we're now starting to see is places that are starting to a move up a bit in prices is places like an umperals recurations electronics household equipment.
segments.zh: 但现在我们看到一些领域价格开始上涨，比如家电、电子产品、家居设备等。

segments.en: Those are things that right now may not look as big. But when you actually see the second order effect given the fact that the street continues to remain closed.
segments.zh: 这些目前看起来影响不大，但考虑到实体零售持续关闭，二阶效应显现时，影响可能不小。

segments.en: You are starting to see these online retailers actually increasing prices with their existing inventories. So that could actually be something that we think the fed could monitor.
segments.zh: 线上零售商正利用现有库存提高价格。我们认为这可能是美联储关注的点。

segments.en: And actually be more hawkish than what the market is thinking right now.
segments.zh: 因此美联储可能比市场预期的更加鹰派。
